name: server-plus
description: Two horizontal server bays beside a plus sign.
useCase: Create a server or add a host to an infrastructure list.
misuse: Label the control with the type of server or host being added.

16.reason: The broad upper bay keeps its indicator and vent, while the lower rim opens around the complete plus sign.

24.reason: The wider bays retain their server profile and clear spacing around the complete plus sign.
